name: Daiku no Medium MEGUMI
source:
This story has a sad ending, but hundreds of others are waiting to be told. Within the walls of the nameless city, or beyond its borders.

[Translated from [url=https://vk.com/wall-149859311_225]VK[/url]]
translation:
这个故事有一个悲伤的结局，但还有数百个故事等待讲述。在无名之城的城墙之内，或者在它的边界之外。

[翻译自[url=https://vk.com/wall-149859311_225]VK[/url]]
